newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-UNITED IN NEW BID TO SIGN BARCELONA'S NADAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNITED IN NEW BID TO SIGN BARCELONA'S NADAL.

text.p: Manchester United manager Alex Ferguson confirmed on Friday he has re-opened talks with Barcelona for Spanish international defender Miguel Nadal.
"The dialogue has started again," he told reporters.

United first bid for the 30-year-old after his impressive performance against England during the European championship in June, but they reportedly baulked at Nadal's 30,000 pound-a-week ($46,500) pay demand.
On Thursday however, United chairman Martin Edwards said money was no longer an issue and suggested a deal, thought to be worth around 3.25 million pounds ($5.0 million), was in the pipeline.

"We understand Nadal wants to join us and something could happen soon," Edwards said. "We are simply awaiting a call from Spain to tell us we can proceed with the transfer. The matter is very much in the hands of the player."

"Nadal is a very good and experienced defender," Ferguson added. "He is used to playing in European football with a top club like Barcelona and I think he would be a good addition to us. We are hopeful that we will get it tied up next week."
